paragraphs: I'm applying for the Security Engineer role on SpaceX's Security Operations team in Hawthorne. I want to build the tooling that lets a security team detect and respond quickly, and doing that for the company launching Falcon and Starlink is a rare place to learn it. I finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine, specializing in Networked Systems, and I'm local to Irvine/Orange County.

Most of my hands-on security work is on CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app I built and still operate on the App Store, backed by Google Cloud. I own its security end to end. My server-authoritative Cloud Functions enforce authentication, input validation and per-user and global rate limiting, and they verify Apple receipts server-side to detect and block subscription fraud. I designed role-based access-control rules that stop IDOR, privilege escalation and message spoofing, and I validate them with 36 adversarial unit tests. Every backend request is checked with Firebase App Check (App Attest).

I automate in Python and Node.js, and in coursework and labs I've used Wireshark and Burp Suite to study MITM, ARP poisoning, DNS spoofing, SQL injection and XSS. I haven't run a production SOC or incident yet, and I'm studying for the CompTIA Security+ exam in January to build that foundation. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I balance a full training load with school and work, so I know how to stay organized when the pace picks up.
I'd welcome the chance to build and operate SecOps tooling with your team, and I'm available to start in Summer 2027.
